Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, run once to print this record's own shape; it reads no PR file and is no gate, build or test. Everything else was read from blobs (`git show`, `git diff origin/main...pr/31428`), the card, the PR body and the head's check-runs.
Scope: skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs

Inputs read: card #31338 (body, 3 comments: triage 6716400526, claim 6716849304, os-dev-report 6717349738); PR #31428 body and file list (3 files: the changeset, the ratchet row, operations.md); the net diff against `main` at the merge base `e6a0b72a90`; `main` `0647dabb` (contains #31369's merge `405a78ea`): `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `packages/types/src/unique-scope-install-gate.ts`, `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `docs/adr/0120`; the skill's `references/plugin-development.md` on the head (not in the diff, read as the home of the two cuts); ruling record 6513306068 on #27847; `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/server/31338-skills-gates-ran.txt`; the 36 check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

What an agent following the head's paragraph does at the `use-runtime` exit-1 stop, each judged against the CLI on `main`:

- **Flag spelling — right.** The skill writes `--confirm-global-uniques` bare, no token. `deploy.ts` L160 declares it `Flags.boolean` and L100 lists it in `CONFIRMATION_FLAGS`, so `confirmationArgv` forwards it as a switch; the two upgrade confirmations keep their TOKEN. The paragraph's "rerun with … `--confirm-upgrade TOKEN` it printed, or `--confirm-global-uniques`" keeps that distinction.
- **Exit code — right.** The embedded `PackageInstall` prints the stop and `this.exit(1)` (install.ts L447-L456); `deployToRuntime` then sees `outcome?.kind !== 'installed'` and exits 1 itself (deploy.ts L358-L362). Exit 1, as the paragraph says.
- **Which stop — right.** The runtime's gate is step 2b of install-local, placed AFTER `if (dryRun) return this.answerUpgradeDryRun(...)` (marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts L2716 then L2735-L2744), so a dry run never raises `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`; it is the install step's refusal. The paragraph files it under "an install refusal", not under "a dry run refused" — the right stop.
- **The printed retry — right.** `deployToRuntime` sets `command.retryCommand = 'os deploy'` (deploy.ts L342) and install.ts L453 prints `${retry} --confirm-global-uniques`, so "it printed" names `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques`, which `os deploy` now accepts verbatim.
- **The alternative — right.** install.ts L454 says "edit the app's metadata to `unique: 'organization'` and rebuild"; `os deploy` begins with the build (deploy.ts L329-L335), so the skill's "set them `unique: 'organization'`" with no "and rebuild" loses nothing. `'organization'` is the ADR-0120 scope the CLI, cli.mdx L3545-L3546 and the spec (`UniqueScopeSchema`, `boolean | 'global' | 'organization'`) all name.
- **"installation-wide `unique` constraints" — right, and deliberately wider than `'global'`.** The gate also reports the deprecated bare `unique: true` spelling (`describeGlobalUniqueFinding`), so naming the constraints by what they do rather than by one spelling matches what the stop lists.
- **Scope of the stop — not stated, not wrong.** The gate fires only under the `isolated` tenancy posture (`postureGatesGlobalUniques`); the paragraph does not say so. An agent on a `single` or `group` runtime never meets it; one on `isolated` meets exactly the text taught. cli.mdx L3270-L3271 names the posture; the skill paragraph does not, which costs an agent nothing at the stop.
- **"(no `--env`)" — still right.** With `--env`, or no runtime recorded, every confirmation flag is refused before any build with exit 1 (deploy.ts L194-L200). That cloud-side refusal is not in the cloud exit-1 paragraph; it is also not in this diff's claim (nit, ④).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31338-platform-skill-global-uniques-stop.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (the package at `packages/skills/package.json`), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. Right on all three: the diff changes teaching text and a gate row only; no published schema, no metadata key, no CLI accept set moves (that widening was #31369's `@objectstack/cli` patch with `Clause-②: yes`, already on `main`). Same shape as the precedent `.changeset/31235-platform-skill-use-runtime-deploy-exit.md` (#31335). The changeset's one-paragraph account ("two ways on"; "`os deploy` already accepts the flag; this release only teaches it"; "two logger and metrics restatements … are cut") matches the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

**The dev's 5 NOT MEASURED gate families against the head's check-runs** (read 2026-11-08 ~07:31Z; 36 check-runs, 0 failed, 14 in_progress):

- `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:lean-entry-closure` — all four live in ci.yml's `Build Core` job. On `da7c715` `Build Core` is **completed / success**, and its job steps "Sweep the built closure for vanished declarations", "Every published require entry point actually loads", "No published source map embeds source text" and "The lean engine entry loads no forbidden or unlisted package" are each **success**. Measured green by CI. (`check:dts-closure` runs again in `Type Check · debt ledger` and `Type Check · consumer gates`: in_progress.)
- `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` — lint.yml `Type Check · consumer gates`, step "Check docs formula examples are valid CEL": **in_progress** at read, not yet a verdict. The diff adds no formula text, so nothing in it can turn that step.

The record file holds 62 rows, 57 × exit 0 and 5 × exit 3, the five above — matches the PR body's account. Complete and green at read: `Build Core`, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Test UI`, `Auto Label`, `filter`. Still running: `Check Changeset`, the eight `Lint ·` lanes (the ratchet gate's own CI run is among them), the four `Type Check ·` lanes, `Live E2E UI`, `Plan Test Core shards`. Landing waits on those; none has turned red.

**The ratchet raise 3375 → 3394, against ruling record 6513306068 (letter B, part 2):** the ruling makes the 2026-10-27 standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 the gate-recognised path for hand-authored `references/**`: a PR whose diff shows deletion of restatement in the same file and whose body quotes that ruling or the record may move the row by the measured remainder, pinned AT the measurement, with no per-card ruling; "the seat record checks the quote". Checked here:

- Population: `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` is hand-authored teaching text — in the ruling's class.
- Deletion in the same file, visible in the diff: two hunks, −36 B (the Logs bullet's `{ level: 'info', format: 'json' }` example, reduced to `new ObjectKernel({ logger })`) and −31 B (the Metrics bullet's "(per-plugin startup durations)"), measured from the two blobs. Both are restatements, each homed: the logger shape at plugin-development.md § ObjectKernel Configuration (L38-L52, `level: 'info'`, `format: 'json'`), the startup durations at § Health Monitoring (L338, `getPluginMetrics(); // Map(name, startup ms)`). The bullets' own facts survive: logger is a kernel-construction option and not a `defineStack` key; metrics are `getPluginMetrics()` + `checkAllPluginsHealth()`, no `metrics` service, no `@objectstack/plugin-prometheus`. No other file in the skill repeats the cut words (grep of `skills/objectstack-platform` on the head: the only hit for `format: 'json'` is the plugin-development.md home; none for "startup durations").
- Quote: the PR body and the row comment both carry the ruling's words verbatim and the record id.
- Measurement: 13500 B → 13574 B (+141 added, −67 cut, +74 net); ceil(13500/4) = 3375 exactly, so headroom was 0; ceil(13574/4) = 3394; the row is pinned at 3394, the remainder +19 as stated. Reproduced from the blobs by the header's `wc -c` convention, not by running the script.
- #10402 principle (no growth for a small feature): +19 tokens buy the one clause an agent at a shipped exit-1 stop had no taught way past; the restatement was cut first. Within the ruling. The raise is within 6513306068.

### ④ Design judgment

`hits` — `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, the `use-runtime` paragraph, read sentence by sentence against the code it cites on `main`:

- "A `use-runtime` target (no `--env`) asks for no cloud login: build, dry-run plan, install, live on `hotLoaded`." Unchanged; still the four steps of `deployToRuntime`.
- "Exit 1: a failed build; a dry run refused, unserved (no install-local) or ignored (an older runtime installed: upgrade it);" Unchanged; matches L329-L350.
- "an install refusal (rerun with the `--confirm-access-upgrade` / `--confirm-upgrade TOKEN` it printed, or `--confirm-global-uniques` if its installation-wide `unique` constraints are meant platform-wide, else set them `unique: 'organization'`);" — the changed clause. Agrees with install.ts L445-L456 (the stop, its two ways on, their order) and with deploy.ts L100/L160 (the flag, boolean, forwarded). "its" is the package's; "them" are the constraints the stop lists. The confirmation is guarded by a condition, not offered as the default.
- "installed but not loaded (live after a restart)." Unchanged; matches L363-L369.

Could an AI follow it into confirming by reflex? The clause makes confirmation conditional on the constraints being "meant platform-wide" and gives the per-organization rewrite as the else-branch, and at the moment of action the agent is reading the stop itself, which prints `GLOBAL_UNIQUE_ISOLATED_PRESCRIPTION` verbatim (why an installation-wide unique under `isolated` crosses customers; the three examples of a genuinely platform-wide key; option (b) rewrite). The skill adds no pressure toward (a). No must-fix.

Findings, graded:

1. **nit** — the clause leads with the confirmation and carries none of ADR-0120's lean ("a `'global'` unique on an app business object is almost always meant company-wide, not cross-customer"; platform-wide = infra/dedup keys, hostnames, external ids). It mirrors the CLI's own order (confirm line first, "…or edit" second) and the stop's printed prescription supplies the lean, so correctness and the contract are unaffected; a later edit at zero headroom could trade words for "only for infra/dedup keys; an app rule is per-organization".
2. **nit** — `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques` is a boolean and confirms every pending index at once (the CLI never sends the body's per-id list), so a mixed set (some genuinely platform-wide, some per-organization) is handled by rewriting the per-organization ones and rerunning; the clause's "if … else" does not say mixed. The same holds for `os package install`; not a claim this diff makes false.
3. **nit** — `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` case 21's `expected_output` still names only `--confirm-access-upgrade` as a refusal's confirmation. Pre-existing (named in #31335's "Other sites found" and this PR's "Not edited"); not a regression of this diff and no eval pins the cut text.
4. **nit** — the cloud exit-1 paragraph does not name the exit-1 refusal of any confirmation flag when the target is ObjectOS Cloud (deploy.ts L194-L200); outside this diff's claim.

Implementing file in the diff — `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the one row moves to 3394 with a comment in the file's established form (what was added, what was cut and where it is homed, the byte arithmetic, the ruling verbatim and its record id). The number agrees with the blob (③). No other row, the header or the counting convention changes. No finding.

Read, not reviewed: `references/plugin-development.md` is not in the diff; both homes named for the cuts exist on the head at the sections cited.
